description: JACKAL mathematical evidence kernel: formal-bounded range/Gaussian/composed-integral/pure-Q fragment enclosures, independent receipt verification, exact CAS lanes with independently re-checkable certificates, honest weaker-lane calculation (exact/checked/estimated/bounded) with status passthrough that never inflates, and the claim-kernel front doors (jackal_claim, jackal_verify_bundle) for compiling and independently replaying content-addressed claim bundles. v1.7.0 adds the certified bound_step composition lane (jackal_integrate_bound_cert, theorem int_cert_sound). v1.7.2 closes the range-ordering and composed-integral proof premises and binds current formal tools to the closed-premise v2 proof identities. v1.8.0 adds two direct, non-fallback Navier-Stokes finite-scope tools with mandatory independent replay and permanent no-global-regularity/no-all-time-smoothness/no-Millennium-solution nonclaims; the Navier lane is not routed through jackal_claim.

tools.name: jackal_range_bound
tools.description: Emit a formal-bounded receipt with the certificate embedded (or refuse).

expression.help: Anubis expression in the single variable x, restricted to the certified fragment.

input_lo.help: Interval lower bound as an integer or reduced ℚ (e.g. '1', '2/3').

input_hi.help: Interval upper bound (canonical rational, hi >= lo).

tools.name: jackal_gaussian_integral
tools.description: Emit a zero-libm formal-bounded Gaussian integral receipt, rerun the pinned checker, or refuse without downgrade.

expression.help: Exact canonical exp(-A*(x-mu)^2) expression; all other expressions refuse.

input_lo.help: Integration lower bound as a canonical rational.

input_hi.help: Integration upper bound as a canonical rational.

tolerance.help: Maximum enclosure width as a positive canonical rational.

tools.name: jackal_integrate_bound_cert
tools.description: Emit a request-bound certified composed definite-integral formal receipt (v1.7.2): the untrusted exact-rational producer mirrors the engine's adaptive subdivision, the pinned Lean-proved jackal_int_cert_check binds the exact raw expression/bounds/tolerance and re-checks the whole subdivision-tree certificate (theorem int_cert_sound), and the receipt is independently re-verified before returning. Request-unbound v1.7.0 receipts are revoked. Certified fragment: num/var/neg/add/sub/mul/div/pow(0..4096)/sin/cos/abs in x. Everything else refuses. The weaker float lane jackal_integrate_bound stays status=bounded and is NOT this tool.

expression.help: Integrand in the single variable x, restricted to the certified fragment (num/var/neg/add/sub/mul/div/pow/sin/cos/abs).

input_lo.help: Integration lower bound as an integer or reduced canonical rational (e.g. '0', '2/3').

input_hi.help: Integration upper bound as a canonical rational, strictly above input_lo.

tolerance.help: Maximum enclosure width as a positive canonical rational (e.g. '1/100').

tools.name: jackal_verify_receipt
tools.description: Re-run the matching pinned Lean-proved checker over an embedded certificate using a closed epoch/variant registry: current v1.7.2 range/rational and request-bound int_cert, replay-only v1.5.0 range/rational, or Gaussian v1.5.0. Request-unbound v1.7.0 int_cert receipts refuse.

expected_release_epoch.help: Caller-authorized release epoch, not copied from the receipt.

expected_expression.help: Exact raw expression supplied by the caller.

expected_input_lo.help: Exact raw lower-bound token supplied by the caller.

expected_input_hi.help: Exact raw upper-bound token supplied by the caller.

expected_tolerance.help: Exact raw tolerance token; required for Gaussian and int_cert receipts and forbidden for range receipts.

tools.name: jackal_navier_stokes_check
tools.description: Run the dedicated Navier-Stokes v1 finite-scope checker, preserve its exact bounded | indeterminate | refused status and halt decision, and independently replay the emitted receipt before returning it. Producer exits are enforced as 0=bounded/non-halt, 2=refused, 3=all other non-bounded outcomes. Canonical requests are capped at 4 MiB and producer/verifier stdout+stderr at 64 KiB aggregate per process. allow_fallback must be false. This direct tool is not routed through jackal_claim and never certifies global regularity, all-time smoothness, or a solution of the Clay Millennium Problem.

request.help: A jackal-navier-stokes-request-v1 object with explicit finite scope, allow_fallback=false, and mandatory nonclaims: not_global_regular, not_smooth_for_all_time, not_millennium_solved.

returns.halt: the producer's exact fail-closed halt decision
returns.result: the producer's complete mathematical result object
returns.receipt: the complete jackal-navier-stokes-receipt-v1 object after independent replay
returns.receipt_replay: verified only after mandatory independent replay
returns.nonclaims: exact request nonclaims; never promoted or removed

tools.name: jackal_verify_navier_stokes_receipt
tools.description: Independently replay a Navier-Stokes v1 receipt against a separate caller-supplied expected request. Canonical receipts are capped at 16 MiB, expected requests at 4 MiB, and verifier stdout+stderr at 64 KiB aggregate. A verified replay authenticates only receipt/checker consistency; mathematical_status remains exactly bounded, indeterminate, or refused and is never upgraded. This direct tool has no fallback and does not route through jackal_claim.

receipt.help: The complete jackal-navier-stokes-receipt-v1 object to replay.

expected_request.help: Caller-authorized jackal-navier-stokes-request-v1 object; never copied from the receipt.

returns.mathematical_status: the unchanged bounded | indeterminate | refused receipt result status
returns.reason: the unchanged mathematical reason, or stable plugin refusal class
returns.result: the unchanged complete mathematical result object
returns.receipt_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical receipt bytes replayed
returns.nonclaims: exact request nonclaims; never promoted or removed

tools.name: jackal_sqrt_rat_bound
tools.description: Emit a formal-bounded pure-Q sqrt(x) enclosure via the untrusted producer + Lean-proved checker. NO libm on the proof-decision path. Admits ONLY the exact form 'sqrt(x)' on a canonical rational interval; every other expression refuses without downgrade. v1.4.0 fragment extension.

expression.help: Must equal 'sqrt(x)' after whitespace normalization.

input_lo.help: Interval lower bound as an integer or reduced rational (e.g. '2', '1/4'); must be >= 0.

input_hi.help: Interval upper bound (canonical rational, hi >= lo).

returns.enclosure: [lo, hi] canonical rationals enclosing sqrt(x) over the input interval
returns.certificate_b64: base64 of the exact canonical certificate bytes the checker accepted

tools.name: jackal_tanh_rat_bound

tools.name: jackal_claim
tools.description: Compile a structured jackal-claim-request-v1 into a canonical, content-addressed jackal-claim-bundle-v1 evidence graph through the deterministic policy router. Routes through exact, current/archival range-family, Gaussian, request-bound composed-integral, machine, and unit lanes; emits a route trace naming candidates and refusal reasons; and refuses rather than silently downgrading (allow_fallback defaults false). The bundle is independently replayable via jackal_verify_bundle.

request.help: jackal-claim-request-v1 object: {schema, steps:[{id, op, ...}], root, policy?, nonce?, emitted_at_unix?, max_age_seconds?, expires_at_unix?}. Step ops: input, exact, enclose, gaussian, integrate_cert, machine, interval_add/sub/mul/div, threshold, decision, convert, and, model, passthrough, attach.

returns.root: root claim-node id (SHA-256 of canonical node bytes)
returns.rendering: deterministic {token, permitted_text} — never a bare VERIFIED badge
returns.route_trace: per-step candidate lanes with selected/refused status and reasons

tools.name: jackal_verify_bundle
tools.description: Independently replay a jackal-claim-bundle-v1 against caller-pinned expectations. The standalone dependency-free verifier recomputes every canonical byte and hash, revalidates the DAG, selects only the closed current/archival range, Gaussian, or current request-bound int-cert checker/proof tuple, re-runs embedded evidence, recomputes machine/unit mathematics, re-evaluates every inference rule and assurance-axis propagation, enforces consequence-class floors and policy, and recomputes the deterministic rendering. Returns verified | refused | indeterminate with exact reasons — never a generic green badge.

expected_release_epoch.help: Caller-pinned epoch (e.g. 'v1.6.0'); never copied from the bundle.

expected_policy_sha256.help: Caller-pinned SHA-256 of the canonical policy bytes.

expected_root_proposition.help: Caller-pinned canonical root proposition IR object.

verification_time_unix.help: Caller-supplied verification time (unix seconds) for freshness/expiry checks.

expected_nonce.help: Caller nonce; the bundle root must bind exactly this nonce.

returns.report: full verifier output lines (axes, artifact flags, freshness, assumptions, residual non-claims, decision binding, rendering token, permitted text)
